source: Derived 20 October 2026 from the board resolution clause list (skeletons/board-resolution.json), the owner's chosen base (a certified copy of a resolution) and the second base (an extract of resolutions).
name: Board resolution drafting decisions
applyWhere: the fixed part named above and the resolution
closing: That completes the drafting decisions. What remains are the facts — the company, the date of the meeting or circulation, the certifying officer, the person authorised, the documents and matters named, and the signatory. Give them to me in the chat, or point me at the project documents that hold them, and I will fill each [●].
